verdict.rationale: Apify offers a marketplace of tens of thousands of pre-built Actors (apify-docs-12) and docs on developing new Actors (apify-docs-1, apify-docs-13) plus an official CLI (apify-probe-4) that developers can use to scaffold projects, suggesting a fast-start path. However, the pack lacks explicit evidence of a curated 'project template' gallery or scaffold command with named templates, so the claim is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a template library/scaffolding command (e.g., 'apify create --template'), and independent hands-on confirmation of template usage.
